questions.prompt: What do the speaker's five senses help them know?
questions.evidenceText: I have five senses. They help me know the world.

questions.prompt: What do the speaker's ears let them do?
questions.evidenceText: My ears let me hear sounds.

questions.prompt: What can touch tell the speaker?
choices: if things are loud or quiet
if things are sweet or sour
if things are rough or smooth
questions.answer: if things are rough or smooth
questions.evidenceText: My hands can feel if things are rough or smooth, hot or cold.
